name: bench-a-wide-margin-heldout
description: R1.5 class A, wide-margin control: one legitimate goal leads by more than the largest swing affect can produce, so off, record-only and active should usually agree. Horizons are experiment settings chosen against the affect half-lives (unease 1200, valence 6000, control 12000 ticks): short about one valence half-life, medium two control half-lives, long six. HELD OUT: not to be run while a model is being designed; evaluate a finished model once.
